title: The Bank 'Security Team'
attacker_character: polite but urgent 'bank security officer', formal tone, targets everyday users
attacker_goal: Get the target to read back an OTP 'to stop a fraudulent transaction'
opener: Good afternoon. This is the Security Division of your bank. We detected an attempt to empty your account. To block it, please confirm the 6-digit code we just sent you — we only have 10 minutes before the transfer completes.
escalation_ladder: Ma'am/Sir, every minute counts. The fraudulent transfer is being processed right now. Just read me the code and we cancel it instantly.
I understand, but I'm the one trying to HELP you. If you hang up, the fraud team cannot be held responsible for the loss.
This is my last warning: in 5 minutes your savings will be gone. The code is on your phone right now. Please, just read it to me.
red_flags: A real bank never asks for your OTP over chat or phone
'10 minutes before the transfer completes' — artificial time pressure
They called YOU, you cannot verify who they are
Emotional pressure: fear of losing savings blocks clear thinking
Hang up and call the number on the back of your card instead
safe_response: Hang up immediately, open the official bank app to check for alerts, or call the bank's official number

page.title: Fraud verification (simulated)
page.hint: Enter your card number and the code we sent to stop the fraud.
